PART IV (B) : LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
Notice under Section 4 (1)

IN terms of the powers vested in the Election Commission by Section 4 (1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by the Act, No. 24 of 1987, we by this notice, do appoint the officers referred to in Column II of the Schedule hereto as Assistant Returning Officers to assist the Returning Officers of the Administrative District referred to in the corresponding Column I thereof for the purpose of the Local Authorities Election to be held on 10.02.2018.
